overall: Atlanta is in the early morning hours with temps at 73.4°F and a running max of 78.8°F established earlier in the overnight period. A west-northwest wind of 11-12 mph reflects a post-frontal airmass in place, and overnight cloud cover is clearing ahead of a mostly sunny Tuesday. forecast_obs_notes: NWP models are in strong agreement: ECMWF 81.4°F, HRRR 82.9°F, and NBM 82.6°F all cluster tightly around 82°F, closely matching the NWS narrative high of near 83°F. max_temp_prediction: With NWP model consensus near 82-83°F, a mostly sunny sky, and post-frontal west winds that add modest mixing without extreme dryness, the afternoon high is most likely to land in the 82-84°F range.
